primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: Average latency to persistent sleep is defined as the length of time elapsed between lights off and onset of persistent sleep (defined as the point at which 10 minutes of uninterrupted sleep has begun as determined by PSG) between Baseline and the average of nights 1 and 8.
